newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 27-day T-bills yielding 27 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 27-day T-bills yielding 27 pct.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry sold 210 million levs of 27-day floater coupon T-bills, yielding 26.91 percent until maturity, the central bank (BNB) said.

The ministry set no par value for the issue and offered it with no minimum acceptable price set in advance for Wednesday's auction in which two financial institutions took part, the BNB said in a statement.
The paper bears a coupon equal to the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the period to maturity.
The BNB raised the CIR to historic high 25 percent monthly or 300 percent annually from 108 percent, effective Tuesday, in a bid to restore confidence in the slumping national currency, the lev.
The BNB's governor Lyubomir Filipov said that new CIR might be considered a temporary measure.
